newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Pernas says to form fund management firm.
newsitem.headline: Pernas says to form fund management firm.

text.p: Malaysian property and hotels group Pernas International Holdings Bhd said on Monday it was planning to form a fund management venture with Citibank.

"We have had discussions with Citibank and we have to make some decisions. The talks have been steady and positive. Now we are sitting down to work out the details," said Mohamed Khadar Merican, Pernas president and chief operating officer.
Khadar told reporters at the release of the group's financial results that the joint firm was expected to materialise after the first half of this year.
"We can expect something (concrete) by the end of June," added Tunku Shahriman Tunku Sulaiman, chairman and chief executive officer of Pernas.
Khadar said Pernas hopes to run the local funds while Citibank will manage the foreign funds.
He said the joint venture partner was likely to be the Singapore operations of Citibank.
Pernas was also preparing submissions to regulatory authorities for the listing of a plantation subsidiary, Khadar said.
The company also plans to list its property assets separately, he said.
